jobs.name: ratel
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for a 96px desktop mascot. Input image 1 is CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not layout: preserve this same animal identity and warm Lion King / Lion Guard 2D hand drawn cartoon look, crisp outlines, restrained cel shadows.
Create exactly EIGHT columns and SEVEN rows, 56 equal SQUARE cells, a 2048×1792 transparent PNG atlas. No gutters, no labels, no grid lines. Every cell contains a single full-body drawing of the same character at the EXACT same scale, position and camera, seated facing slightly left. Head centered near (128,75) in each 256px cell, body centered at (128,150), feet baseline y=235. Leave 12px safe margin everywhere, including raised hand and ears/tail. Torso and feet stay registered; ONLY articulated hands, forearms, eyelids and expression change. No bobbing, no rotation of whole character, no camera motion, no zoom.
CRITICAL: DO NOT DRAW ANY DESK, TABLE, LAPTOP, COMPUTER, CHAIR OR FLOOR in any cell. Those will be stationary separate layers in the app. Paws for typing reach the invisible keyboard around x=105..160,y=170. The animal is at its workstation in ALL states.
Each ROW is an eight-frame chronological smooth animation, left to right. Draw actual intermediate poses, not eight duplicates.
Row 1: typing loop. Alternate left and right paws pressing keys in small clear arcs, fingers/claws move, stable focused face. First and last smoothly connect.
Row 2: thinking. Hand progressively goes from invisible keyboard to chin, thoughtful eyes glance upward, taps chin, hand returns down. Eight smooth in-between drawings.
Row 3: idle gaming. First two frames hand reaches beside body and pulls out an original gray GAME BOY handheld with dark green screen, black cross D-pad and two burgundy buttons. Frames 3..8 hold the Game Boy in both paws at chest height, looking down and pressing buttons with alternating thumbs. Prop clearly visible, no text on it.
Row 4: task finished. Happy smile, gradually raises ONE OPEN hand from keyboard level to beside head over frames 1..5, then a friendly small wave with open palm in frames 6..8. Other paw stays down. No fist, no jumping. Smooth hand-raising in-betweens.
Row 5: coffee. Mug moves progressively from desk-height hand to lips, takes sip, lowers mug again, eight in-betweens.
Row 6: reading. Holds a small notebook, eyes scan page, turns one page with intermediate finger and page poses, returns to reading.
Genuinely transparent alpha background, completely isolated cutouts, no gradients, no colored panels, no ground shadows. No text/watermarks. Preserve the referenced species, clothing, proportions, colors across all 56 frames.
Row 7: problem / needs help. Worried raised eyebrows; gradually raises one hand to scratch the side of the head, two small finger scratches, puzzled expression and a brief open-palm "what happened?" gesture, then lowers hand. Eight actual smooth intermediate drawings. No question mark or exclamation drawn inside the image; app adds badges.
Subject: the same cheeky gray honey badger / ratel with creamy white head-to-tail mantle, green eyes, black paws, short honey-badger tail, no clothes.
